summary_md: **nick ([@nickvernij](https://x.com/nickvernij/status/2115736975378436502))** had his agents fit NVIDIA's 30B **Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe** onto a 24GB M5 Pro Mac, finding a mixed quantization under 17GB with about 0.1 WER penalty plus a custom kernel reaching about 150 tok/s ([divergentlabs MLX build](https://huggingface.co/divergentlabs/Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-MLX)).
relevance: Agent-driven quantization search for local speech models.
